name: Logging in does not offer the Warchief's Command zone orders again
contract: Issue #7536: a level 60 Horde character was offered Warchief's Command pop-ups (SMSG 0x927 {quest, 0}) on every login, also for zones far below its level and orders it had dismissed many times. The client does not report a dismissed pop-up to the server, so a zone order is offered only on the level-up that unlocks it. Logging in twice at level 60 sends no further offer of the level 55 orders Warchief's Command: Winterspring! 14229 and Warchief's Command: Silithus! 14241 (the two a login offered before), nor of the level 10 order Warchief's Command: The Barrens! 14232.

steps.label: the level 60 character logs in again
the character logs in a third time
logging in does not offer Warchief's Command: Winterspring! again
logging in does not offer Warchief's Command: Silithus! again
logging in does not offer the level 10 Warchief's Command: The Barrens! order
